editorial:
Imagine being trapped in a dark tunnel with no way out while the air slowly runs out. That is the nightmare you get into with this movie. You follow a brave mother who is just trying to get her son to the hospital. The catch is that her son needs a constant supply of oxygen to survive. When their car gets stuck in a massive traffic jam inside a tunnel, the situation turns into a race against time. The vibe is super tense from the start, and you can really feel the panic as the oxygen tank starts to empty. It makes you wonder what you would do to save your own child when everything is going wrong.

What really makes this work is the lead actress who brings so much emotion to the role. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the side characters feel a bit flat. If you like movies that keep you on the edge of your seat, you should definitely give this one a try. For the best experience, I suggest streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail in the dark tunnel. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this high-tension ride.
endingExplained: In the end, the mother does everything possible to keep her son breathing while the other trapped people start to panic. After a lot of fighting and struggle, rescue teams finally break through the tunnel walls. The son is saved just in time before the oxygen completely runs out. The movie wraps up by showing that her love and refusal to give up were the only things that kept her son alive during the crisis.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and high-stakes drama.
